subject: Assertion sampling and owner roster request
messages:
From: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@remedyhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@remedyhealth.com
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SAML/SCIM samples + role-owner mapping for SIG

Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As part of our SIG questionnaire we need a handful of sample artefacts to validate your access control controls (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC). Can you provide the following within the next 5 business days?

1) Two redacted SAML assertion samples from production authentication flows (one interactive web SSO, one API-service account flow). Please redact PII but leave the attributes & nameID formats in tact so we can verify attribute mapping.
2) SCIM delta for the last 90 days (CSV preferred) showing add/update/delete events with timestamps and actor where available.
3) Role-owner roster (CSV) that maps role names to owner (name + email) and scope (global/tenant/service-account).
4) A short justification document for any privileged/system accounts that remain active (why they are needed, duration, mitigation controls).
5) A short note on your sampling methodology and where raw logs will be stored / retention policy.

We will treat anything marked as evidence under our intake process. Delivery via a secure shared drive or SFTP link is preferred. If you need an NDA addendum or an encrypted channel, let me know.

Goal: validate attribute mappings and least-privilege evidence for SIG and the CAIQ spot checks.

-David
David Nguyen
Senior InfoSec Analyst, Remedy Health
security@remedyhealth.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@remedyhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM samples + role-owner mapping for SIG

Thanks David — we can handle this. A few clarifying questions before we start collecting to make sure we align on scope: 

- Do you need full-tenant assertion samples, or is an anonymized tenant/scoped sample sufficient for attribute verification?
- For SCIM delta: you asked for actor where available. Do you need full user IDs (we can provide hashed IDs) or just role/service-account names plus timestamps?

Proposed split and timeline (we can tighten if you need faster):
- SAML assertion samples (redacted): 3 business days
- SCIM delta 90d export (CSV, hashed user ids): 4 business days
- Role-owner roster & privileged account justification: 4 business days
- Sampling methodology + retention note: included with the evidence pack

Delivery options: secure Drive folder (preferred) or SFTP. We will upload a ZIP containing the redacted assertions and the CSVs and include a readme describing redaction.

I am copying Laura and Grace — Laura will own the role-owner roster and privileged justification; Grace will help with SCIM exports and redaction controls.

We will flag anything that contains PII and provide redaction notes. If Remedy needs the raw, unredacted artifacts under an NDA, we can coordinate that separately.

–Jonas
Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Dec 2025 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM samples + role-owner mapping for SIG

Looping in timeline and resource notes. Jonas — happy to take lead on the role-owner mapping and privileged account justifications. Plan:

- I'll run the role-owner export from the IAM system and normalize to your CSV template (role_owner_roster.csv). Will include columns: role_key, role_display_name, owner_name, owner_email, scope, created_at, last_reviewed_at.
- For privileged accounts we'll produce a short PDF (privileged-account-justification.pdf) that lists account, purpose, approval owner, and mitigation (MFA, session limits, keyed secrets rotation).
- Grace will pull the SCIM delta; note that SCIM logs include raw user identifiers — we'll hash user ids using a one-way salt and include the salt hash metadata in the readme so you can verify sampling integrity without exposing PII.

Sean — tagging you in case we should schedule an internal brief to redact anything flagged as sensitive before upload.

If David confirms anonymized tenant samples are fine, we'll proceed and target a delivery by Tue EOD (Dec 2). If Remedy requires unredacted raw assertions, call that out and we'll route to legal for an NDA/amendment.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: David Nguyen <david.nguyen@remedyhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Delivery: SAML/SCIM samples + role-owner roster (Remedy Health evidence pack)

David — delivering the evidence pack we discussed. Files are in the secure folder below (link shared with Remedy Health security group):

- saml_assertion_samples_redacted.zip (2 XML files: interactive_web_assertion.xml, service_account_assertion.xml) — nameIDs and PII masked; attributes preserved
- scim_delta_90d.csv — events (add/update/delete) with hashed user_id and actor where available
- role_owner_roster.csv — normalized role -> owner mapping
- privileged-account-justification.pdf — short justification + approvals and mitigation controls
- evidence_collection_plan.md — summary of sampling methodology, retention, and redaction steps

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink
HubSpot ticket: HB-30412

Notes / caveats:
- We hashed internal user IDs with a per-evidence salt and included the salt checksum in evidence_collection_plan.md so your team can validate the mapping if needed.
- The SAML samples are production-flow assertions but redacted for PII; we preserved attribute names, formats, and timestamps to validate mapping.
- If Remedy needs unredacted logs for audit, please send an NDA addendum; we can provide a controlled access bucket for time-limited review.

Please confirm receipt and let us know if you need any additional artifacts or a short walkthrough.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

--
Attachments: saml_assertion_samples_redacted.zip, scim_delta_90d.csv, role_owner_roster.csv, privileged-account-justification.pdf, evidence_collection_plan.md
